map.年初与年末税额不同是累计口径的必然结果，不必误判为算错: The tax differing between the start and the end of the year is an inevitable result of the cumulative method, so do not mistake it for a calculation error
map.为什么年初和年末个税不同？: Why is the tax different at the start and the end of the year?
map.累计预扣法下，累计所得跨入更高税率档后，后期月份的预扣税额会增加，属正常现象。: Under the cumulative withholding method, once cumulative income crosses into a higher bracket, the withholding in later months rises. This is normal.
map.专项附加扣除有哪些？: Which special additional deductions are there?
map.子女教育、赡养老人、住房贷款利息或租金、继续教育、大病医疗、婴幼儿照护等，需据实: Children's education, support for the elderly, housing loan interest or rent, continuing education, serious illness treatment and infant care all have to be declared truthfully.
map.月数为什么会影响个税？: Why does the number of months affect the tax?
map.月数是累计预扣的计税期数，不是简单把单月税额乘以月数。工具假设 1–N 月每月收: The number of months is the tax period for cumulative withholding, not a simple multiplier of the monthly tax. The tool assumes identical income and deductions in months 1–N, so cumulative income grows with the month count and may cross brackets; current-month tax equals cumulative tax through this month minus cumulative tax through last month.
map.结果和工资条不一致？: The result differs from my payslip?
map.基数、比例与扣除项因单位与城市而异，且工具默认各月收入相同；请以单位申报与工资条: The contribution base, rates and deduction items vary by unit and city, and the tool assumes identical monthly income; rely on what your employer declares and your payslip.
